description: This file defines the TpTimer class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace, implementing a timer with start, stop, and callback functionalities, including an inner class TpTimerJob for job management.

classes.name: TpTimer
classes.description: A timer class that manages scheduling and execution of timed callbacks, supporting single-shot and recurring modes.

classes.name: TpTimerJob
classes.description: An inner class used to encapsulate timer job details and comparison logic for scheduling.

methods.name: TpTimer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the timer with default parameters.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Returns whether the timer is currently active.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the timer and revokes scheduled jobs.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the timer with the previously set interval.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the timer with a specified interval in milliseconds.

methods.name: setSingleShot
methods.description: Configures the timer to run only once if set to true.

methods.name: setInterval
methods.description: Sets the interval in milliseconds for the timer.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects a callback function to be called on timer timeout.

methods.name: Timed
methods.description: Internal method invoked when the timer elapses, executing the callback and managing repeat logic.
